name: com.rpgmmo.shared-gamelogic
description: Deterministic simulation logic and game-content schema shared by the .NET game server and the Unity client: movement, combat, validation, AOI, game constants, and the content definitions both sides load (ADR-19). Compiled from source on both sides so client prediction and the authoritative simulation agree, and so both agree on what content means. Ships golden vectors under GoldenVectors/ that both sides replay as a conformance gate (ADR-10).
